svg.title: Datum site analysis: Atlanta, Georgia
svg.desc: Generated 2026-09-25T04:33:58.335Z. Sources listed in the attribution group. Coordinates 33.77513, -84.39198.

g.text: heights known for 14 of 140 buildings; levels known for 49. contours at 5 m. FEMA flood polygons unavailable

text.tspan: Walking speed 80 m per minute. Start node 2 m from the site point. Unreached streets in the fetch extent are faint.

g.text: Grid 21 by 21 at 40 m, contour interval 5 m
group none assigned, drainage not given, order not given, slope not given, hydric No

text.tspan: SSURGO maps this as Urban land: the natural profile is disturbed or covered and no
hydrologic group is assigned.
A site specific geotechnical investigation is required before any foundation decision.

g.text: Land area 1,764,443 m2. Margins of error are stored with the estimates.
ASCE 7-22, RISK CATEGORY II, SITE CLASS D
Site class is the default, not measured

text.tspan: Site Class D and Risk Category II are defaults. A site specific geotechnical report is required to
confirm site class.
FEMA flood data could not be reached (upstream_error). Verify at msc.fema.gov.
Overhang projection over glazing height is 1 / tan(summer solstice noon altitude): geometry only, no site
obstructions.

g.text: Band: mean daily minimum to maximum. Tick: monthly mean. Dashed: relative humidity, 0 to 100 percent over the band height.
Hours between 18 and 26 C with relative humidity under 70 percent. Simple comfort band, not ASHRAE 55.

text.tspan: The site sits at 281.7263 m elevation [topo.siteElevationM]. Relief across the survey
grid reaches 29.9 m [topo.reliefM]. East-west sections range from 275.195953369 m to
297.06161499 m, a spread of roughly 22 m [topo.sections.ew[]]. North-south sections
are tighter, from 280.842529297 m to 288.553924561 m [topo.sections.ns[]]. Mean slope
is 6.2 percent [topo.meanSlopePct] with an aspect of 311.6 degrees [topo.aspectDeg],
meaning the ground faces northwest. The steeper east-west fall drives the entry level
decision: expect a split-level or stepped section rather than a flat datum. Soil is
mapped entirely as Urban land, 100 percent of the component
[soil.components[].percent], with no drainage class, hydrologic group, or slope
recorded [soil.components[].drainageClass, soil.components[].hydrologicGroup,
soil.components[].slopePct]. Geotechnical investigation is essential before sizing
footings or designing infiltration stormwater. Seismic Design Category is B under
ASCE 7-22, site class D assumed as default [seismic.sdc,
seismic.assumptions.siteClassIsDefault]. SDS is 0.21 g and SD1 is 0.13 g
[seismic.sds, seismic.sd1]. Category B is low demand but the default site class
should be confirmed by a geotechnical report.
Cooling degree days are 985.4 and heating degree days are 1398.9, both on a base of
18.3 C [climate.degreeDays.cdd, climate.degreeDays.hdd, climate.degreeDays.baseC].
The climate leans toward heating but cooling is significant. Only 13.2 percent of
hours fall in the simple comfort band [climate.comfortShare.pct]. July mean daily
maximum is 32.18 C and January mean daily minimum is 1.35 C
[climate.monthly[].meanDailyMaxC, climate.monthly[].meanDailyMinC]. Peak solar
radiation arrives in June at 6.502 kWh/m2/day
[climate.monthly[].meanDailyRadiationKwhM2]. June noon solar altitude is 79.6625
degrees, nearly overhead, so horizontal overhangs need only an overhang-to-glazing
ratio of 0.1824 to shade south glass at summer solstice [sun.june.noonAltitudeDeg,
sun.overhangRatioSouthGlazing]. December noon altitude drops to 32.7871 degrees,
favouring deep south glazing for passive gain [sun.december.noonAltitudeDeg].
Prevailing wind is 315 degrees (northwest) in all seasons
[climate.wind.annual.prevailingSectorDeg, climate.wind.summer.prevailingSectorDeg,
climate.wind.winter.prevailingSectorDeg]. Winter mean speed is 3.502 m/s
[climate.wind.winter.meanSpeedMs]. Because the slope faces 311.6 degrees
[topo.aspectDeg], the northwest face takes both winter wind and driving rain.
Minimise openings and maximise insulation on that elevation.
The surrounding area has a building coverage ratio of 0.3563 and 140 buildings mapped
[osm.stats.coverageRatio, osm.stats.buildingCount]. Only 14 buildings carry height
data and 49 carry level data [osm.stats.withHeight, osm.stats.withLevels], so shadow
modelling will be incomplete without field survey. There are 41 transit stops within
the walkshed [walkshed.transitWithin.15]. A 5-minute walk reaches 12 stops and 10.9
km of street network [walkshed.transitWithin.5, walkshed.reachKm.5]. Car-free commute
share in the census tract is 35.3 percent [census.derived.carFreeCommutePct] and 633
workers walked to work [census.walkedToWork]. Bicycle-to-work count is 40
[census.bikeToWork]. These figures support reduced parking provision and investment
in secure cycle storage and a clear pedestrian entry. Median age is 20.3 and average
household size is 1.78 [census.medianAge, census.avgHouseholdSize], suggesting
small-unit, amenity-rich programming. Renter share is 94.3 percent and multifamily
share is 94.5 percent [census.derived.renterSharePct,
census.derived.multifamily5plusSharePct].
Seismic risk is low. PGA is 0.12 g and Seismic Design Category is B [seismic.pgam,
seismic.sdc]. Confirm site class D assumption before structural system selection
[seismic.assumptions.siteClassIsDefault]. Soil data carries no drainage class or
hydrologic group [soil.components[].drainageClass,
soil.components[].hydrologicGroup], so surface runoff behaviour is unknown. The 6.2
percent mean slope [topo.meanSlopePct] on an urban soil unit means runoff will be
rapid. Size stormwater detention conservatively until a geotechnical report clarifies
infiltration capacity. July mean relative humidity is 73.22 percent and August is
72.87 percent [climate.monthly[].meanRhPct], raising envelope moisture risk on a
northwest-facing slope. A robust drainage plane and vented cladding are advisable.
Flood zone data is unavailable because FEMA flood data could not be reached due to an
upstream error. Verify the flood zone classification directly at msc.fema.gov before
fixing the ground floor

Fonts: Fraunces, IBM Plex Mono, Inter. Substituted when not installed, which is acceptable for a tracing base.
Every value traces to a named source and field. An unavailable source shows an unavailable panel, never a default or an estimate.
